## DOCUMENTED LIMITATION:
Concurrent single-flight race: two truly-simultaneous POSTs (within the same event-loop tick) can both create jobs before either persists. In the real chat case (user double-tap, requests staggered by network latency), single-flight attaches correctly. Fix would require an atomic claim lock — deferred as non-blocking since real-world duplicate-submission is staggered.
